query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber:'38.214'}) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL WITH DISTINCT cr UNWIND [token IN split(cr.clausesAffected,',') WHERE trim(token) <> ''] AS raw WITH cr,collect(DISTINCT trim(raw)) AS clauseTokens WHERE size(clauseTokens)>=5 RETURN cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,size(clauseTokens) AS tokenCount,clauseTokens
